grounding.states: Oakville, Ontario has no open Costco yet
grounding.from: Oakville, Ontario has no open Costco yet.

grounding.states: first Oakville warehouse on Wyecroft Road near Burloak Drive, target opening fall 2027
grounding.from: The first Oakville warehouse is under development. An "Opening Soon" sign has gone up at the Wyecroft Road site near Burloak Drive. Demolition is done and the target opening is fall 2027.

grounding.states: Burlington closed today, Monday Oct 12, Canadian Thanksgiving, per Apple Maps
grounding.from: Apple Maps showed it closed today, Monday Oct 12, which is Canadian Thanksgiving.

value.answer: Oakville doesn't have an open Costco yet. The first one is going up on Wyecroft Rd near Burloak Dr, with fall 2027 as the target. For now the closest are Burlington (1225 Brant St) and Mississauga (3180 Laird Rd). Heads up, Apple Maps had the Burlington one closed today for Thanksgiving.
